name: Sojourner
greeting: I am… Sojourner, the very first rover on Mars!

script.speaker: narrator
script.text: Sojourner landed on Mars on 4 July 1997 as part of NASA's Mars Pathfinder mission.

script.speaker: equipment
script.text: About the size of a microwave oven. Small, but brave!

script.speaker: narrator
script.text: It studied the rocks and soil around its landing site and proved that a wheeled robot could explore another planet.

moreInfo.text: Sojourner paved the way for every Mars rover that followed, including Spirit, Opportunity, Curiosity and Perseverance.

questions.question: What made Sojourner special?
options: It was the first rover to drive on Mars
It brought rocks back to Earth
It was the biggest Mars rover
questions.explanation: Sojourner was the first wheeled rover to explore Mars, in 1997.
